name: GDELT-tone macro regime gates greed continuation-long (calm-macro herding)
rationale: MECHANISM: the other leg of the gdelt_tone regime switch. When broad tone is NEUTRAL/POSITIVE (macro risk-on) AND crypto greed is extreme AND momentum is up (ret_Nd>0), continuation works — the herding is happening in a supportive macro backdrop that lets the FOMO trend persist rather than get cut short by a macro shock. This resolves the family's central tension by using the SAME slow macro-tone series to pick continuation (here) vs contrarian (hh-16), avoiding the whipsaw of applying one rule in both regimes. Long; exit when momentum fades or tone turns negative, or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: run the continuation leg UNGATED vs tone-GATED — if the macro-positive gate does not improve OOS DSR over ungated greed continuation, gdelt_tone adds no regime information; kill. Also verify gdelt_tone actually leads the regime turn at the daily horizon or it cannot gate in time.
catalyst: positive macro tone AND extreme crypto greed with up-momentum
